# goslop text fixture — best-effort probe with defined return-None fallback
# (niquests extensions/pyodide to_py / read FP shape)
lang: python
file: pyodide_read.py
---
def get_next_chunk(reader):
    try:
        result = run_sync(reader.read())
        if result.done:
            return None
        value = result.value
        if value is not None:
            return bytes(value.to_py())
        return None
    except Exception:
        return None
